review.tagline: Kanban board that runs coding agents in per-issue git workspaces
review.summary: Vibe Kanban pairs a kanban board for planning with workspaces where coding agents execute, each with its own branch, terminal and dev server. You review diffs, leave inline comments that go back to the agent, preview the app in a built-in browser, and open pull requests. The README announces the project is sunsetting.
review.audience: Developers who run several CLI coding agents in parallel and review their diffs
strengths: Works with 10+ agents, including Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot, Amp and Cursor
Starts with one command: npx vibe-kanban
Inline diff comments are sent straight to the agent
Built-in preview browser with devtools, inspect mode and device emulation
weaknesses: README states the project is sunsetting
Last release was 2026-04-24, months before the latest commit
Each coding agent must be installed and authenticated separately
Maintainers ask that PRs not be opened without prior discussion
needs: Needs Node.js >=20, Git, an authenticated coding agent CLI
Models: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Amp
